scope: Supplemental whole-card UI review of four Chapter VIII samples; initial and final states at 320 and 1280 CSS pixels

reviewer.role: Integration author and independent UI reviewer; not author/editor of the four sampled lesson bodies or models

reviewedTree.state: Uncommitted candidate content; the base commit alone does not identify the reviewed files

coverage.target: Entire lesson main: title, chapter/paragraph caption, condition, drawing, source disclosure, learner answer area where present, complete help column
coverage.excluded: Other 160 Chapter VIII cards, intermediate step drawings, alternate-case drawings, catalog-wide layout, persistence, live site and publication approval

method: First inspected all 16 original whole-main PNG files by contiguous vertical slices at native resolution. Two long mobile captures repeated the header at approximately 8192 pixels, hiding the final tail.

Repeated all 16 captures from candidate3 using a real browser at a fixed 900-pixel viewport height. Each scroll viewport PNG is retained with a hash; exact cropped rows are concatenated without rescaling.

Verified by decoded-pixel comparison that the complete composite consists of every recorded viewport row in order with no gap. Viewed every row of all 16 replacement composites at native resolution: mobile strips on 11 contact sheets and desktop vertical slices. No inference from DOM or model hashes replaced manual image reading.

Initial means a fresh temporary browser context and neutral drawing with help closed; source disclosure was deliberately opened. Final means the actual last step drawing with every step explanation and its justification expanded; the separate overall-result disclosure remains closed.

captureEvidence.rawEvidenceManualField: The capture reports remain unchanged with manualImageInspection=pending; this separate report records the later actual manual review.

findings.description: Oversized element screenshot repeats page header after approximately 8192 pixels, so the original final320 theory73 and exercise736 PNGs cannot certify their complete last step.
findings.resolution: Actual fixed-viewport captures retain all 8483 and 9366 rows. Last-step explanations, justification and final drawing buttons were manually read in their entirety. No runtime or lesson change was needed.

observations.result: Correct problem heading and caption; AB/CD segment labels readable; two-step ratio and unit-conversion flow fits both widths; learner response field remains visible.

Long title wraps within the card; height-condition initial drawing and final field-measurement drawing are readable. All six steps are present. Step 6 visibly distinguishes the printed 153 m example from approximately 146.08 m implied by the stated angles.

observations.source: Chapter VIII with no invented paragraph; printed 188 / PDF 189
observations.result: Three supplied lengths in the initial drawing; final triangle/centroid labels A,B,C,G,K,M,N readable; six-step construction, existence and mirrored-solution explanation is fully visible. Alternate-case controls are readable, but their drawings are outside this review.

observations.source: Chapter VIII with no invented paragraph; printed 185 / PDF 186
observations.result: Self-check heading and open-ended answer field shown. Segment labels, ratio definition and unit-invariance explanations remain readable at both widths.

No horizontal overflow, missing source caption, clipped meaningful label, concealed final step or premature worked explanation observed. Narrow why-link buttons sometimes wrap within words and long mobile cards require vertical scrolling; text remains available and readable.

sourceAndModelWorkflow.scope: one non-browser source-and-models workflow pass on corrected VIII working tree; public1083 remains published
